name: Charts by Szum
description:
After connecting, start a new chat and say: "Use Charts by Szum to create an editorial bar chart from this data: North 42, South 35, East 28, West 31.".

Charts by Szum helps Claude turn plain-language requests and raw data into publication-ready charts. It can explore curated themes and examples, validate the chart definition, and display an interactive preview with an SVG or PNG image link. When you want to keep a result, save it for permanent image and interactive embed links, then reopen, update, rename, or delete it from Claude or Szum Studio. Useful for reports, presentations, product work, and dashboards.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Charts by Szum to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Charts by Szum to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://szum.io/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Charts by Szum MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Charts by Szum scores 93/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Charts by Szum MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Charts by Szum provides these MCP tools: delete_chart, get_chart, get_chart_config, get_examples, list_charts, list_marks, list_themes, rename_chart, render_chart, save_chart, update_chart, and validate_chart.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Charts by Szum?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Charts by Szum in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Charts by Szum MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Charts by Szum does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Charts by Szum is developed by Bartosz Prusinowski. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
